Bug-fix release with real installers for every platform.

*Fejlrettelse: spektrogrammet og piano roll vises nu korrekt på macOS, og der er nu
installationsprogrammer til macOS, Windows og Linux.*

## Fixes

- **macOS: spectrogram and piano roll rendered incorrectly.** On macOS JUCE stores RGB images
  as 4-byte ARGB, but the spectrogram wrote 3-byte RGB pixels into them. Colours were swapped
  and the alpha channel held uninitialised memory, so the spectrogram – and the piano-roll grid
  drawn on top of it – showed garbage. The spectrogram now renders into an ARGB image on all
  platforms.
- Fixed a compiler warning (shadowed variable) in the pitch detector.

## Downloads

| Platform | Installer | Portable |
|---|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel) | `Soundstave-0.2.1-macos-universal.dmg` – open and drag *Soundstave* to *Applications* | `…-macos-universal.zip` |
| Windows (64-bit) | `Soundstave-0.2.1-windows-x64-setup.exe` | `…-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (Debian/Ubuntu, x86-64) | `soundstave_0.2.1_amd64.deb` – `sudo apt install ./soundstave_0.2.1_amd64.deb` | `…-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The apps are not signed by Apple or Microsoft:

- **macOS:** the first time, right-click the app → *Open*. On macOS 15 or later, open
  *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway*.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen appears, click *More info* → *Run anyway*.
